days.note: Hike to Glacier Vista, cross the Nisqually Glacier and climb past the Castle camps to Camp Hazard.
days.title: Paradise to Camp Hazard

days.note: Alpine start to climb the Kautz Headwall's 1-2 short ice pitches (up to ~50°) and the ice chute to the summit, then descend the Disappointment Cleaver to Paradise.
days.title: Summit day

itinerary.totalNote: A standard 2-day trip (~9,000 ft gain) — essentially the Kautz Glacier route with 1-2 short ice pitches on the headwall itself.
